title: Round-1 factorial: one guiding policy vs base count vs data volume
question: Why do the small (~50 base per task) chains drop at round 1: sudden one-policy guided share, few distinct base episodes, or too little data?
headline: Label check: base and guided episodes are labelled alike (40% positive, mean A ~0) in every chain, dropping or not; the cause is not in the labels. Arms A-D (subsets of the 900 chain's r7 table, frozen 900 V, no demos, 2 seeds) + r0 controls submitted; results pending.
